mapper.select: SELECT d.employee_id AS employee_id, e.full_name AS full_name, d.license_no AS license_no, d.title AS title, d.specialty AS specialty, (SELECT string_agg(c.clinic_name, '、' ORDER BY c.clinic_id) FROM dentist_clinic dc JOIN clinic c ON c.clinic_id = dc.clinic_id WHERE dc.employee_id = d.employee_id) AS clinic_names, (SELECT string_agg(q.qualification_name, '、' ORDER BY q.qualification_id) FROM dentist_qualification dq JOIN qualification q ON q.qualification_id = dq.qualification_id WHERE dq.employee_id = d.employee_id) AS qualification_names, (SELECT MIN(q.valid_until) FROM dentist_qualification dq JOIN qualification q ON q.qualification_id = dq.qualification_id WHERE dq.employee_id = d.employee_id) AS earliest_expiry FROM dentist d JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = d.employee_id WHERE e.status = '在职' ORDER BY d.employee_id
mapper.update: UPDATE clinic SET status = #{status} WHERE clinic_id = #{clinicId}
mapper.select: SELECT qualification_id AS qualification_id, qualification_name AS qualification_name, issuing_authority AS issuing_authority, valid_until AS valid_until FROM qualification ORDER BY qualification_id

SELECT qualification_id AS qualification_id, qualification_name AS qualification_name, issuing_authority AS issuing_authority, valid_until AS valid_until FROM qualification WHERE qualification_id = #{qualificationId}

SELECT dq.dq_id AS dq_id, dq.qualification_id AS qualification_id, q.qualification_name AS qualification_name, q.issuing_authority AS issuing_authority, q.valid_until AS valid_until, dq.obtain_date AS obtain_date, dq.certificate_no AS certificate_no FROM dentist_qualification dq JOIN qualification q ON q.qualification_id = dq.qualification_id WHERE dq.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY q.qualification_id

SELECT dc.dc_id AS dc_id, dc.clinic_id AS clinic_id, c.clinic_code AS clinic_code, c.clinic_name AS clinic_name, dc.schedule_note AS schedule_note, dc.is_primary AS "primary" FROM dentist_clinic dc JOIN clinic c ON c.clinic_id = dc.clinic_id WHERE dc.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY dc.is_primary DESC, dc.clinic_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dentist WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dentist_qualification (employee_id, qualification_id, obtain_date, certificate_no) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{qualificationId}, #{obtainDate}, #{certificateNo})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dentist_qualification WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND qualification_id = #{qualificationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dentist_clinic (employee_id, clinic_id, schedule_note, is_primary) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{clinicId}, #{scheduleNote}, #{isPrimary})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dentist_clinic WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND clinic_id = #{clinicId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dentist_clinic SET is_primary = 0 WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
